SELECT ,
( (CASE WHEN title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN language LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) )
AS match_score
0 AS match_score
FROM dev_asset WHERE deleted = 0
AND type = #{type}
AND tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tag}, '%')
AND is_favorite = #{isFavorite}
AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR language LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') )
ORDER BY match_score DESC, updated_at DESC

SELECT
FROM dev_asset a INNER JOIN ( SELECT asset_id, MAX(created_at) AS last_used FROM dev_asset_usage GROUP BY asset_id ) u ON a.id = u.asset_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.last_used DESC LIMIT #{limit}
